desc: Totino's Triple Cheese Flavored Pizza Rolls turn an epic pizza topping into a tasty poppable bite you can enjoy any time. Every serving excites your taste buds with a triple cheese flavored filling inside bite-sized pockets of goodness, baked to a golden finish. From chill nights on the couch or gaming with friends to hosting a gameday crowd, Totino's Pizza Rolls are the perfect savory snack. Frozen Totino's Pizza Rolls are ready whenever you are. Heat them up in no time with no fuss. Pop 'em in the microwave, oven, or air fryer following the easy directions on the package. Ideal for teens, keep a stash in your freezer for when they crave a bite before heading out the door. Want to switch things up at snack time? Try serving Totino's Pizza Rolls alongside your favorite dips or a marinara sauce. Make these flavorful cheesy, pizza flavored snack bites an alternative to frozen pizza. Fun to eat, add them to any party spread as an ideal finger food that brings out the smiles. With 50 Totino's Pizza Rolls and about 8 servings in this package, there's plenty to go around.
features:
• PIZZA ROLLS: Tasty triple cheese flavored filling inside bite-sized pockets of goodness, baked to a golden finish; Heating directions on the back, deliciousness on the inside

  • QUICK AND EASY: Simply pop in the microwave, oven, or air fryer and enjoy in minutes; Perfect alongside your favorite pizza bagels, mini corn dogs, taquitos and other frozen snacks

  • CROWD PLEASER: Whether you're grabbing a quick snack or hanging with friends, Totino's Pizza Rolls are ready when you are; Serve as is, or pair with other pizza ingredients, sauces, or dips

  • TEEN OR KIDS SNACK: After school snack time has never tasted so good; When your teens need a hot, convenient snack, help them smash their hunger with Totino's Pizza Rolls

  • CONTAINS: One 24.8 oz bag of Totino's Triple Cheese Pizza Rolls; 50 count; About 8 servings
